description: KNaSiF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.69-3.15 Å. Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.82 Å. Si is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Si-F bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.74 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Si atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, two equivalent Na, and one Si atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Si atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one K, three equivalent Na, and one Si atom.
